finding: OpenTopoMap is a light basemap (land #e2bb7c-#fbedb1) with dark thin linework (contours/rivers to #993816/#0c6eb2). No single stroke colour reaches 3:1 against both the light land and the darkest linework, so every overlay line fails the all-tones check. Against area tones only, a dark casing passes; recommended fix is a #0b141b halo under each stroke (and optional 0.5px white outer casing over linework), or the darker strokes listed.

ruling.fix: 1.5px #0b141b dark halo under each failing stroke + 0.5px #ffffff outer edge (always-on, intended for contour crossings); every colour kept as is
ruling.not_haloed: passing dark era strokes #8a5a14 #3f6d8e #7c2f2a #5a4a8a #2b5d5d; battle area glow exempt
ruling.note: re-measure if the site ever dims the basemap
